empty_states.no_events: No learning events yet. When Naya detects something worth keeping, it will appear here — with its proof tag attached.
empty_states.nothing_proven: Nothing proven yet. The system is still learning — here is what is being watched:

mock_rules.ribbon_style: black background, 1px purple bottom edge, purple glow shadow, white 14px caps — purple accent/glow only, never solid fill
mock_rules.sections: populated-feed (one sample card per rung) + nothing-proven section (verbatim empty_states.nothing_proven, LEARNING-rung cards only)
mock_rules.expand: tap toggles layers with 200ms ease max-height + chevron rotate 180deg; prefers-reduced-motion => instant

note: This surface is a read-only projection of the canonical learning-event envelope. The envelope lives on the open, unmerged PR #2296 branch — not on main. The surface is blocked on #2296's merge or a re-stack behind it; rung_mapping is pinned to the envelope contract as published on that branch. It defines no event schema of its own.

CHECKED.label: Checked
CHECKED.means: Verified by tests or a different Naya seat. Not on live production.

LEARNING.label: Still learning
LEARNING.means: In progress; we're watching, not claiming.

rung_mapping.learning_override: Any event whose mapped rung is BUILT and whose age from the envelope's issued_at is < 24h renders as LEARNING. Events at CHECKED or PROVEN_LIVE always render their true rung regardless of age. There is no LEARN-lane in-flight trigger: the envelope has no in-flight field.
rung_mapping.upgrade_rule: Rung upgrades only via the underlying envelope transition. The surface never upgrades a rung on its own.
